name: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Details
description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer must be clearly declared.

name: Common/Generic Name
description: The common or generic name of the packaged commodity must be declared on the principal display panel.

name: Net Quantity Declaration
description: Net quantity in standard SI units (g, kg, ml, L, N) must be declared without ambiguous suffixes.

name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
description: Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes must be declared in mandatory prescribed wording.

name: Manufacture/Packing/Import Date
description: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import (MM/YYYY or Month YYYY) must be clearly stated.

name: Consumer Care Details
description: Name, address, telephone number, and email address of person/office for consumer complaints.

name: Country of Origin
description: Country of origin must be declared for imported products or manufactured items.

name: Best Before / Use By
description: Best before or use by date must be declared for food, perishables, and consumable commodities.

name: Unit Sale Price
description: Unit sale price must be declared (e.g., ₹/g, ₹/kg, ₹/ml, ₹/unit) for package containing >1 unit/g.

name: Dimensions Declaration
description: Dimensions of the commodity must be declared where size/area is relevant to standard measurement.

name: MRP Standard Formatting
description: Price must strictly state 'MRP ₹... (incl. of all taxes)' or 'MRP Rs ... (inclusive of all taxes)'.

name: Image-Based Font & Readability Screening
description: Mandatory declarations must satisfy minimum letter height standards (Rule 7) and be legible/prominent (Rule 9).

name: 2026 Amendment: Country-of-Origin Declaration
description: As per Feb 2026 amendment effective July 1, 2026, product listings and packaging must have searchable/prominent origin tags.
